Named page_1.json per the framework's page_N filename convention (whole catalogue as one page, like golden/vetapet_vet). Replaces the old-PDF pages 51-53 extract (['page_51.json', 'page_52.json', 'page_53.json']). Golden S&C SKU prices verified unchanged (240/488/212). Kept in expected.csv verbatim (the sheet is the source); they never publish, so covered_skus stays at the 3 S&C rows (alfamedic precedent for named-but-absent SKUs).
